label: Streamflow / discharge
definition: Volumetric flow rate of water past a stream, canal, ditch, or spring gauge.
comparability: USGS 00060 daily mean, USBR HydroData flow, USACE Flow, CO DWR DISCHRG, and OSE daily average flow are the same quantity. Provisional vs approved values can differ; check qualifier.

label: Flow volume over the interval
definition: Total volume of water passing a gauge during the interval (usually one day).

label: Gage height / stage
definition: Water surface height above the gauge datum. Datums differ by site and can be reset; not comparable across sites.

label: Water temperature
definition: Temperature of surface or ground water at the sensor.

label: Diversion flow
definition: Flow rate diverted from a river into a canal, ditch, or acequia at the point of diversion.
comparability: Same quantity as discharge measured on a conveyance; kept separate so river vs canal terms are explicit in a water balance.

label: Diversion volume
definition: Volume diverted during the interval.

label: Return / drain flow
definition: Flow returning to a river from drains, wasteways, or wastewater outfalls.

label: Suspended sediment concentration
definition: Mass of suspended sediment per volume of water.

label: Suspended sediment discharge
definition: Mass of suspended sediment passing the gauge per day.

label: Reservoir storage
definition: Volume of water stored in a reservoir at the observation time, per the operator's current elevation-capacity table.
comparability: USGS 00054, USBR datatype 17, USACE Stor, and NRCS RESC all report storage but may use different capacity tables (sedimentation resurveys change them). Treat as equivalent_method and compare with care across revisions.

label: Reservoir pool elevation
definition: Water surface elevation of a reservoir. Vertical datum (NGVD29 vs NAVD88) is noted in the crosswalk caveat.

label: Reservoir release / outflow
definition: Total flow released from a dam (outlet works, spillway, power).

label: Reservoir release volume
definition: Volume released during the interval.

label: Reservoir inflow
definition: Computed or gauged inflow to a reservoir.
comparability: Often computed as release + change in storage + evaporation; not an independent measurement.

label: Reservoir inflow volume
definition: Inflow volume during the interval.

label: Reservoir evaporation
definition: Estimated evaporative loss from the reservoir surface during the interval.

label: Reservoir surface area
definition: Water surface area at the observed elevation.

label: Change in storage
definition: Storage at end of interval minus storage at start.

label: Precipitation
definition: Depth of liquid-equivalent precipitation falling during the interval (incremental).
comparability: NOT the same as precip_accumulated_wy. GHCN PRCP and USGS 00045 are daily totals; NRCS PRCP is the daily increment of the accumulation gauge.

label: Water-year accumulated precipitation
definition: Cumulative precipitation since 1 October, as reported by NRCS storage gauges (element PREC). Differencing gives incremental precip.
comparability: related_not_comparable to precip; convert by differencing consecutive days within a water year.

label: Snowfall
definition: Depth of new snow during the interval.

label: Snow water equivalent
definition: Depth of water contained in the snowpack at the observation time.
comparability: NRCS WTEQ (pillow), snow-course measurements, GHCN WESD (manual), and gridded SNODAS/UA SWE all estimate the same quantity by different methods.

label: Snow depth
definition: Total depth of snow on the ground.

label: Snow density
definition: SWE divided by snow depth, as percent.

label: Air temperature
definition: Air temperature at the station's standard height. Use the statistic column (mean/max/min/instantaneous).

label: Relative humidity
definition: Relative humidity of the air.

label: Wind speed
definition: Wind speed at the station's anemometer height.

label: Wind direction
definition: Direction the wind blows from, degrees clockwise from north.

label: Solar radiation
definition: Incoming shortwave radiation, mean over the interval.

label: Vapor pressure deficit
definition: Saturation minus actual vapor pressure.

label: Reference evapotranspiration
definition: Evapotranspiration from a reference crop surface (grass ETo or alfalfa ETr; see caveat) computed from weather data. A demand ceiling, not actual ET.

label: Actual evapotranspiration
definition: Estimated actual evapotranspiration from the land surface over the interval (remote sensing or model based).

label: Soil moisture (volumetric)
definition: Volumetric water content at the sensor depth; depth is in the site/sensor metadata.

label: Soil temperature
definition: Soil temperature at the sensor depth.

label: Depth to water below land surface
definition: Distance from land surface down to the water level in a well. Positive downward; negative means flowing/artesian above land surface.
comparability: USGS 72019, NMBGMR/NMWDI depth-to-water, OSE well levels, and CO DWR water levels are the same quantity. Manual tape vs transducer readings are equivalent_method.

label: Groundwater level elevation
definition: Elevation of the water level in a well above the vertical datum named in the caveat (NGVD29 or NAVD88).
comparability: Derived from depth to water and a surveyed measuring-point elevation; datum differences of ~1 m between NGVD29 and NAVD88 must be reconciled before comparison.

label: Specific conductance
definition: Electrical conductance of water normalized to 25 C.

label: Total dissolved solids
definition: Mass of dissolved solids per litre.

label: pH
definition: Hydrogen ion activity.

label: Dissolved oxygen
definition: Concentration of dissolved oxygen.

label: Turbidity
definition: Optical turbidity.

label: Nitrate as N
definition: Nitrate concentration expressed as nitrogen.

label: Chloride
definition: Chloride concentration.

label: Sulfate
definition: Sulfate concentration.

label: Arsenic
definition: Total or dissolved arsenic concentration (see caveat).

label: Fluoride
definition: Fluoride concentration.

label: Uranium
definition: Uranium concentration.

label: Water withdrawal
definition: Water withdrawn from surface or ground water for a use category, per area and period.

label: Consumptive use / depletion
definition: Portion of withdrawal not returned to the hydrologic system (evaporated, transpired, incorporated, or exported).

label: Return flow volume
definition: Withdrawal minus consumptive use, returned to surface or ground water.

label: Palmer Drought Severity Index
definition: Palmer index for a climate division or grid cell.

label: Palmer Hydrological Drought Index
definition: Palmer hydrological index.

label: Palmer Z index
definition: Palmer moisture anomaly (Z) index; monthly departure without the PDSI memory term.

label: Modified Palmer Drought Index
definition: Palmer Modified Drought Index (operational PDSI variant used by NOAA CPC).

label: Standardized Precipitation Index
definition: SPI; timescale in months is given in the source_param (e.g. sp03 = 3-month).

label: Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index
definition: SPEI; timescale in source_param.

label: Percent area in drought category
definition: US Drought Monitor percent of area at or above the category named in source_param (D0..D4).

label: Drought Severity and Coverage Index
definition: USDM DSCI (0-500).

label: Seasonal streamflow volume forecast
definition: NRCS/RFC forecast of runoff volume for a forecast period at an exceedance probability given in source_param.
